text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san, I heard that today is your 
birthday.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Forgive my presumption, but as a token of 
my daily gratitude, I'd like to prepare a 
gift for you, Creek-san. May I ask what 
you like?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, now! Oh, Yaeno-chan, you're being far 
too formal...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, thank you very much. Though really, 
just the thought alone is more than 
enough~

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"No. Just the thought alone is nowhere 
near enough. I would at least like you to 
choose one."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A bear for land, a shark for the sea—such 
is my rule. By presenting the mightiest of 
offerings, I hope to convey a fragment of 
my daily gratitude—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my... Yaeno-chan really is strong, 
isn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, if Yaeno-chan suddenly appears, 
both the bears and the sharks are gonna 
get startled~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So... let's see~. Let's make a little bear 
and a little shark out of sugar craft to 
put on top of the cake♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I'll teach you how to make it, so could 
you prepare some for me~?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Sugar confectionery from me... 
U-Understood. If Creek-san desires it, no 
matter how difficult a challenge it may 
be...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm looking forward to it~♪
